entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.5
entry.summary: **Fix: loading a saved project no longer leaves track 1 silent or reset (#30).** When a project loads, MPC sets T1 Machine to its maximum (ROM48) right after restoring the saved sound. Machinemodule applied that, so track 1 moved to a machine that makes no sound without ROM samples, and its synth values were reset. That jump is now ignored while a project or plugin is loading, and whenever ROM48 could not sound anyway. Checked on a Live III: track 1 keeps its saved machine and values after reloa

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: **Fix: no more little hiccups every few bars while a sequence plays.** The track meters reported their levels to MPC from inside the audio callback about ten times a second, and MPC sometimes held that call for around 20 ms, which stalled its audio for a moment. The meters now report from a separate normal-priority thread: they still move on the plugin screen, and no latency is added. On a Live III the audio stalls went from about ten per minute to none, also with every core busy. Same download

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.3
entry.summary: **Fix: pressing Stop twice no longer resets the voices.** MPC's plugin host sets the first parameter (T1 Machine) to its maximum and back on every Stop; if that jump got applied, track 1's SYN values and machine were reset. The engine now ignores that transient jump. Same download as before: nothing of Elektron's inside; put your own Elektron_SPS1-1UW_OS1.63.syx in the plugin's machinedrum/ folder.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.2
entry.summary: **Lower CPU on Gen2 (MPC Live III).** The engine and voice threads now run on the Live III's fast cores (Cortex-A76). The least-busy core choice used to pick the slow Cortex-A55 cores, because MPC keeps the fast ones busy. Measured with a kit playing: engine and voice threads about 37-40% of a core, was 81-92%. Gen1 (Force, MPC Live/One/X): unchanged. Same download as before: nothing of Elektron's inside; put your own Elektron_SPS1-1UW_OS1.63.syx in the plugin's machinedrum/ folder.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.0
entry.summary: Machinedrum emulator for Gen 2 MPCs (public download: nothing of Elektron's inside; bring your own OS file, and optionally the flash `.bin` for ROM machines and factory kits). New in v1: - Mixer page: mute, solo, meters; mute groups. - Master effects (reverb, delay, EQ, dynamix) on the GLOBAL and FX tabs. - CTR control machines: CTR-AL, CTR-RE / GB / EQ / DX, CTR-8P. - Machine logos and descriptions in the picker. - The installer keeps your `machinedrum/` folder on upgrade.
